title: Ametion ore
description: Minecraft’a yeni bir maden ve ekipman seti ekler. / Adds a new ore and gear set to Minecraft.
body:
### 🌍 English Description

**Ametion Mod – New Ore and Equipment Set**

This mod adds a brand new ore, *Ametion*, to the Minecraft world! You can find Ametion deep underground and process it to craft a full set of powerful tools, weapons, and armor with unique abilities.

**Features:**

* **New Ore:** Ametion ore is found deep beneath the surface, waiting to be discovered.
* **Complete Equipment Set:** Craft swords, axes, pickaxes, shovels, and armor made from Ametion with enhanced durability and special features.
* **Balanced Gameplay:** Designed to integrate seamlessly with Minecraft, providing a balanced experience without overpowering the game.
* **Custom Visuals:** All new items come with unique models and textures to enhance immersion.
